description: This collection comprises 20 human‑observed Mycena renati records, all uniformly classified from kingdom Fungi to species Mycena renati. Each record includes a unique GBIF occurrence ID, an iNaturalist link, a catalog number and a common dataset key. Geographically the data span 11 European countries, latitudes 0‑57.63°, longitudes –0.75‑57.34°, with uncertainties up to 1 831 m. Temporal information spans 2012‑2026, allowing analyses of seasonal patterns and distribution changes over time. The semantic profile links taxonomy, precise coordinates, uncertainty, licensing (CC‑BY‑NC‑4.0, CC‑BY‑4.0, CC0‑1.0), media and attribution, supporting mapping, phenology and broader fungal biodiversity research.
